description:
Outcome: Gardener sees own plot and season dates (brief.md: First version must 3).
Scope: Household dashboard for pending, waiting and allocated states, plot label and dates. Excludes: other household identities/contact details.
Acceptance: Current status truthful after allocation/release; no allocation distinct from failure; season dates shown.
Behaviour: Safe session expiry. Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: All status states, ownership checks and phone walkthrough. Prerequisites: T-007, T-008. Assumptions: none.
title: Show gardener application and allocation status
